_comment: Approach A: harden the whole `cpus` cluster (entity cpus, arch one_cpu_m0_gf180) as ONE macro -- J4 core + pure-ROM boot memory (bootram_infer(boot_mem_gf180), now ROM-only, no vendor SRAM) + the bootmem_onewait_inst/data bridges. All std cells (CPU regfile/TLB are fabric flops; boot is logic-only ROM) -- no macro nesting. Util slightly below j4_core (30) for the added boot/onewait glue headroom.
_comment_clock: 100ns loose clock for the AREA/floorplan harden (OL_TO=Magic.WriteLEF, no timing signoff). CPU debug_o cone is a ~49ns unpipelined path; at 20/40ns the post-CTS resizer thrashed. Die/LEF area is clock-independent.
